# Mathematics coverage

<!-- Generated by tools/coverage.py. Edit mathematics-coverage.json instead. -->

An initial, explicitly scoped survey and tested implementation. Not a census of all mathematics and not a proof of universality.

Representation status applies only to each record's explicit scope. Catalog-only rows are initial triage, not established minimality results. Native registrations use Algebra and the existing operations interfaces; the optional Domain/Structure prototype does not execute those registrations. Implementation, empirical testing and mathematical proof are independent axes.

Each row is a scoped assessment, not a unit of all known mathematics. No universal coverage percentage is defined. CATALOG_ONLY records are provisional triage, not working implementations. MACHINE_TESTED counts linked implementation scopes; it does not count independent tests or certify an entire field. Sources aid discovery and do not certify these mappings.

### Cross-domain operations

| Concept | Representation | Implementation | Scope |
| --- | --- | --- | --- |
| boundary value problem solution | REQUIRES_EXTENSION | CATALOG_ONLY | Function spaces and boundary regularity required |
| conditional distribution | REQUIRES_EXTENSION | CATALOG_ONLY | Zero-probability/general conditional laws require appropriate hypotheses |
| constant zero | DIRECTLY_SUPPORTED | IMPLEMENTED | Nullary constant encoded by the singleton domain |
| curl in oriented Euclidean three-space | REQUIRES_EXTENSION | CATALOG_ONLY | Three-dimensional oriented Euclidean convention |
| determinant | DIRECTLY_SUPPORTED | IMPLEMENTED | Two by two rational catalog domain; matrix implementation supports larger positive sizes |
| differentiation of C1 functions | REQUIRES_EXTENSION | CATALOG_ONLY | Requires differentiability evidence; no arbitrary callback accepted |
| divergence | REQUIRES_EXTENSION | CATALOG_ONLY | Regularity and dimension required |
| dot product | DIRECTLY_SUPPORTED | IMPLEMENTED | Fixed dimension two over Q |
| finite simplicial Betti numbers | DIRECTLY_SUPPORTED | IMPLEMENTED | Unreduced homology dimensions over F2; finite ordered degree list, no integer torsion |
| fundamental group | REQUIRES_EXTENSION | CATALOG_ONLY | Base point and homotopy classes matter; not a point-set enumeration |
| general function composition | REQUIRES_EXTENSION | CATALOG_ONLY | Executable scoped function objects are supported; general extensional function-space laws need witnesses |
| general function evaluation | REQUIRES_EXTENSION | CATALOG_ONLY | General total function spaces require totality and extensionality contracts |
| gradient | REQUIRES_EXTENSION | CATALOG_ONLY | Smoothness, coordinates and domain must be explicit |
| homology of a space | REQUIRES_EXTENSION | CATALOG_ONLY | Choose degree/coefficient conventions and chain model |
| initial value problem solution | REQUIRES_EXTENSION | CATALOG_ONLY | Candidates, existence and uniqueness must be separate |
| integer comparison | DIRECTLY_SUPPORTED | IMPLEMENTED | Exact integer order |
| integer to rational inclusion | DIRECTLY_SUPPORTED | IMPLEMENTED | Exact BigInteger rational embedding |
| law of a random variable | REQUIRES_EXTENSION | CATALOG_ONLY | Measurability and source measure required |
| matrix eigenspaces | REQUIRES_EXTENSION | CATALOG_ONLY | A basis is not the entire infinite family of eigenvectors |
| matrix eigenvalues | REQUIRES_EXTENSION | CATALOG_ONLY | Spectrum and algebraic multiplicity are distinct from a set of values |
| matrix times vector | DIRECTLY_SUPPORTED | IMPLEMENTED | Matching fixed rational dimensions |
| measure integral | REQUIRES_EXTENSION | CATALOG_ONLY | Fixed measure, integrability and almost-everywhere equivalence required |
| natural to integer inclusion | DIRECTLY_SUPPORTED | IMPLEMENTED | BigInteger inclusion |
| polynomial derivative | DIRECTLY_SUPPORTED | IMPLEMENTED | Structural polynomial differentiability only |
| polynomial evaluation | DIRECTLY_SUPPORTED | IMPLEMENTED | Univariate rational polynomials |
| prediction versus observation | SUPPORTED_WITH_COMPOSITION | CATALOG_ONLY | Verdict requires an explicit comparison rule and assumptions; no CCDR-specific model |
| rational addition | DIRECTLY_SUPPORTED | IMPLEMENTED | Exact normalized rational arithmetic |
| rational division | DIRECTLY_SUPPORTED | IMPLEMENTED | Undefined for zero divisor |
| rational to rational complex inclusion | DIRECTLY_SUPPORTED | IMPLEMENTED | Rational complex subfield only |
| rational to symbolic real expression | DIRECTLY_SUPPORTED | IMPLEMENTED | Finite symbolic expressions; not all R |
| scalar times vector | DIRECTLY_SUPPORTED | IMPLEMENTED | Fixed dimension two over Q |
| tangent space at a point | REQUIRES_EXTENSION | CATALOG_ONLY | Codomain depends on both inputs |
| vector transformed by scalar | DIRECTLY_SUPPORTED | IMPLEMENTED | A x B -> A may change the first value |

| time-series objects | DIRECTLY_SUPPORTED | CATALOG_ONLY | Finite ordered rational observations with explicit indices |

## Open extensions

- [certified-laws](RFC_LAWS_AND_EQUIVALENCE.md): Law statements and finite tests do not establish universally quantified laws, extensional equality or proof obligations.
- [analytic-membership](RFC_INFINITE_AND_ANALYTIC_DOMAINS.md): Smoothness, convergence, completeness and integrability cannot be inferred from an arbitrary executable callback or a finite prefix.
- [measure-semantics](RFC_INFINITE_AND_ANALYTIC_DOMAINS.md): General measures require measurable spaces, countable additivity and almost-everywhere equivalence; finite weights alone lose this meaning.
- [dependent-domains](RFC_DEPENDENT_DOMAINS.md): The carrier or result membership depends on a value such as a base point, dimension, parameter or geometric base object.
- [quotients](RFC_LAWS_AND_EQUIVALENCE.md): Representatives must be identified under an explicit equivalence and operations must descend independently of representative choice.
- [symbolic-backends](RFC_EXTERNAL_MATHEMATICAL_SYSTEMS.md): Exact algebraic/spectral objects need certified symbolic representations and algorithms beyond the rational subset shipped here.
- [solution-certificates](RFC_EXTERNAL_MATHEMATICAL_SYSTEMS.md): A candidate solution does not establish existence, uniqueness, completeness of a solution family or numerical convergence.
- [gluing](RFC_DEPENDENT_DOMAINS.md): Local data, restriction maps and gluing/descent conditions are essential; a finite set of points or labels loses this structure.
- [higher-coherence](CATEGORY_THEORY_ANALYSIS.md): Objects and arrows alone omit identities, composability, equality, universe size and (for higher cases) coherence data.
